## 2. Avoid

- **Also avoid:** Raw-kernel claims without benchmarks and correctness tests

## 3. Types that do not apply

- **Model / model family:** kernel work targets operators (attention, GEMM), not model families
- **Data store:** not screened
- **Specialised product:** profilers are listed as infrastructure tools; no specialised products
- **Protocol / standard:** not screened
- **Regulation / framework:** not part of this role
- **Business & product:** not screened
- **Domain knowledge:** domain-agnostic
- **Research craft:** not expected; leaderboard results and upstream PRs serve as proof

## 4. Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills)

- None recommended.

## 5. Prerequisites and proof

- **Prerequisites:** Systems / C++ / CUDA background or a PhD.
- **Proof to show:** GPU MODE leaderboard submissions; kernel PRs to vLLM, SGLang, FlashInfer or Triton, benchmarked on the target hardware with correctness tests.
- **Posting terms (measured or cited):** CUDA, Triton, CUTLASS, kernels, GPU, compiler, XLA, performance.
